value.rationale: The source studies stable/unstable Hopf cycles and bistability. The accepted identity gives a finite-amplitude, parameter-explicit restriction on every compact recurrent statistical state and converts the mean infective coordinate into an exact measure of combined fluctuation relative to the two endemic branches. It is therefore a motivated diagnostic for the system’s central oscillatory regime rather than a routine local Taylor expansion or numerical recomputation.
